answer_1.quote: Our model enables modeling all aspects (speaker information, goals, dialog acts, utterances, and general dialog flow) of goal-oriented dialogs in a disentangled manner by assigning latents to each aspect.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialog turns including utterances, goals, dialog acts, and speaker information.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE-L F1-score to evaluate the linguistic quality and utterance-level unigram cross-entropy (regarding the training corpus distribution) to evaluate diversity.
